title: Grateful Dead Live at Universal Amphitheatre on 1973-06-30
source: Audience Source Tape: Reel dubbed in 1979 by Will Boswell (3 3/4ips) from Jerry Garcia's personal collection. Original recording made by the sound crew at the soundboard; Transfer info: Akai GX636 direct tape head output > Bottlehead tube tape pre w/ a pair of Telefunken tubes circa 1960 > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Poorly documented audience transfer that appears down‑sampled; musical performance not discussed.
ai_review.review: The reviewer is frustrated by the lack of clear notes explaining why this version exists and suspects the file has been heavily down‑sampled, resulting in reduced audio fidelity. No comments are made about the actual performance, leaving the show quality indeterminate. Overall the release is judged negatively due to inadequate documentation and questionable sound quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one low‑star review focusing on missing information and possible downsampling; no positive musical comments, so rating is near the bottom of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes file size is ~¼ of comparable versions, suggesting down‑sampling; lacks clear documentation of transfer process, leading to perceived loss of fidelity.
